name: imcp
description: Expose iMCP tools through an authenticated bridge.
instructions: Install the public standalone plugin repository at https://github.com/diegopetrucci/stavrobot-imcp-plugin. Its repository root must contain manifest.json; maintainers publish the contents of plugin/imcp/ at that root, while consumers install the published URL rather than the monorepo subtree. Manually prepare the host bridge, then configure bridge_url and bridge_token through Stavrobot web settings or a trusted host-side secret path; never paste bridge_token into agent chat. The default bridge URL is http://host.docker.internal:8766/bridge. The token is used only for authentication and is never included in tool responses or errors.

bridge_url.description: HTTP URL of the host iMCP bridge.

bridge_token.description: Bearer token configured for the host iMCP bridge.
